title: Rory and the Velvet Clover Knoll
verses:
The sun dipped away as the evening grew still,
The shadows were purple and deep,
While Rory stepped up on a velvet green hill,
Where blossoms were nodding to sleep.

Then Nia swooped down from the soft summer sky,
Where stars were beginning to gleam,
And Psittaco hummed as the breeze rustled by,
As gentle and sweet as a dream.

Now Ricky crept forward to sit in the shade,
With Tilly beside him to rest,
They gathered in peace in the clover-sweet glade,
Like birds settling into a nest.

Then Benny strolled in with a lumbering hum,
And lowered his head to the ground,
For nighttime had whispered that slumber had come,
Without any trouble or sound.

Close into the circle did Rory now lean,
To tuck all his loved ones up tight,
Surrounding their beds in the velvety green,
Beneath the soft glow of the night.

The meadow was peaceful and shadowy blue,
As breathing grew rhythmic and slow,
The clover was sprinkled with drops of sweet dew,
And Rory was nodding below.
